rationales.1: The lede carries the finding whole and every rail row prints its actual figures beside the encoding, so a reader who decodes nothing still receives the entire record.
rationales.2: Charts are named and described and the gaps are drawn as gaps, but the season-total bars run from a 550 mm baseline, so a 587 to 634 mm difference reads as roughly a threefold difference in bar length.
rationales.3: The instrument change is a structural break in the rail itself, the three null years are full-width no-record bands carrying their reasons, and the 2019 flag rides its own line in every view.
rationales.4: The keeper's log and the parish minute are set inline at the years they belong to, and the mid-rail aside earns its place by naming what the preceding lines just showed.
rationales.5: Measure, rhythm and hierarchy hold in both modes, and the rail survives 375 px intact rather than clipping the way a wide table would.
rationales.6: The base page is static and fully readable, with no motion and no pacing imposed on the reader.
rationales.7: The almanac rail is the idea: read downward, the onset dot visibly walks rightward across thirty-four lines, so the shift is felt rather than merely asserted.
rationales.8: One deliberate break, the rail standing in for the conventional chart-plus-table pair, is taught by an inline how-to-read block while the mechanics stay conventional.
rationales.9: Sustained, plain and local throughout, including the closing line that no average on this page reaches across the missing years as if they were there.
rationales.10: Nearly every device traces to something the dataset shows, but the bar length overstates what the season totals actually differ by.
